sentences.en: The pilot explained to us why the landing was delayed.
sentences.zh: 飞行员向我们解释了为什么着陆被推迟。

sentences.en: Most airplane accidents allegedly occur at landing or takeoff stages.
sentences.zh: 据称大多数飞机事故发生在起飞或着陆阶段。

sentences.en: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
sentences.zh: 我爷爷认为登月是骗局。
